tasks.title: Create src/store/projects.js — base store with useObjectStore
tasks.description: Create Pinia store useProjectsStore with useObjectStore(register: planix, schema: project). Expose projects, activeProject, loading, error.
acceptance_criteria: Store created with correct register and schema

tasks.title: Implement fetchProjects(filters)
tasks.description: Call objectStore.getObjects with member filtering. Handle loading/error state.
acceptance_criteria: Members filtered server-side or client-side with documentation

tasks.title: Implement fetchProject(id)
tasks.description: Call objectStore.getObject(id). Handle 403 by setting error to forbidden and redirecting.
acceptance_criteria: 403 sets error to forbidden and redirects to /projects

tasks.title: Implement createProject(data)
tasks.description: POST with status: active and members: [currentUserUid]. Call createDefaultColumns on success.
acceptance_criteria: status and members merged into data

tasks.title: Implement updateProject(id, data)
tasks.description: Call objectStore.updateObject. Update projects array and activeProject in place.

tasks.title: Implement createDefaultColumns(projectId)
tasks.description: Read default_columns from admin settings with hardcoded fallback. POST each column. Return { created, failed }.
acceptance_criteria: Admin settings read with fallback to hardcoded defaults
Returns { created, failed } without throwing on partial failure

tasks.title: Implement archiveProject(id)
tasks.description: Call updateProject(id, { status: archived }). Remove from projects list.

tasks.title: Implement deleteProject(id)
tasks.description: Cascade delete: timeEntries → tasks → columns → project. Show toast on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Toast shown on failure, cascade halted

tasks.title: Implement addMember(projectId, userUid)
tasks.description: Append uid to members[] with duplicate guard.

tasks.title: Implement removeMember(projectId, userUid)
tasks.description: Filter out uid from members[]. Return count of tasks assigned to uid in this project.
acceptance_criteria: Returns assigned task count for warning dialog

tasks.title: Implement leaveProject(projectId)
tasks.description: Call removeMember for currentUser. Return { isLastMember: true } if members would become empty.
acceptance_criteria: Returns isLastMember: true without removing if last member
